data.notes: September 2026’s confirmed Bali music calendar is currently stronger on cultural performance, folklore, rhythm, and Latin dance gatherings than on large announced DJ lineups.

events.title: Taman Ayun Barong Festival
events.summary: Official Indonesia Travel listing confirms this free cultural festival at Pura Taman Ayun, centered on Barong tradition and a Barong Competition alongside cultural workshops and exhibitions.

events.title: Buleleng Bali International Rhythm Competition (BBIRC)
events.summary: World Festival Association confirms BBIRC in Lovina, Buleleng, welcoming international dance and rhythm groups with a cultural parade, performance slots, and gala awards program.

events.title: ODAC Cuban Salsa Fiesta 2026 Bali Edition
events.summary: Eventbrite listing by ODAC Singapore confirms a Bali edition featuring Cuban salsa workshops, masterclasses, and exclusive parties with international Cuban salsa artists.

events.title: Nusantara International Folklore Festival – Ubud, Bali
events.summary: NIFF’s official event page confirms a non-competitive folklore gathering in Ubud where dance and music groups from around the world present cultural performances, workshops, and ceremonies.
